name: Two powerful new ways to customize your surveys
summary: YourOpinion blog post: generate a survey theme from any URL or import an existing shadcn/ui theme.
description: Product update announcing two ways to match survey design to a brand: AI generation of a theme from any website URL (fonts, colors, spacing, layout auto-detected) and importing an existing shadcn/ui theme through the survey's colour palette settings.
